sourceTitle: Easy Vanilla Almond Milk Chia Seed Pudding
sourceText:
Easy Vanilla Almond Milk Chia Seed Pudding
By: Valerie Fidan
Published: Wednesday, March 5, 2014 - 3:42pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups (355 ml) almond milk (or your favorite flavored milk)
1/4 cup black chia seeds
1 teaspoon vanilla bean powder (or vanilla extract)
1 tablespoon raw agave syrup
A pinch of salt
Garnish: Raspberries (or your favorite berry)

Preparation

1 Mix ingredients together in small bowl. Let sit overnight, top with your favorite berries and enjoy!

About

This pudding is healthy enough for a morning breakfast or for an after dinner guilt-free dessert.
